chapter.heading: Psalm 54
The Lord Upholds My Life
To the choirmaster: with stringed instruments. A Maskil(1) of David, when the Ziphites went and told Saul, “Is not David hiding among us?”
chapter.v: and vindicate me by your might .
give ear to the words of my mouth .
they do not set God before themselves . Selah
the Lord is the upholder of my life .
in yourfaithfulnessput an end to them .
I will give thanks to your name , O Lord ,for it is good .
and my eye haslooked in triumph on my enemies .

footnotes.footnote: 54:1 Probably a musical or liturgical term
54:3 Some Hebrew manuscripts and Targum *insolent men* (compare Psalm 86:14)
